description: Add stripMarkdown utility to lib/guides.ts for stripping markdown syntax before rendering in plain-text contexts (e.g. GuideRevealBlock)
steps: Open lib/guides.ts

Add: `export function stripMarkdown(str: string): string { return str.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '$1').replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '$1').replace(/`(.*?)`/g, '$1').replace(/_{1,2}(.*?)_{1,2}/g, '$1').trim() }`
Test: stripMarkdown('**Bulk-billing** means you pay *nothing*') === 'Bulk-billing means you pay nothing'

description: Create useGuideSteps hook that persists step completion as a bitmask integer in localStorage
steps: Create hooks/use-guide-steps.ts
Constant: `const STORAGE_PREFIX = 'minuri:guide:steps:'`
Signature: `function useGuideSteps(slug: string, count: number): { isChecked: (i: number) => boolean; toggle: (i: number) => void; checkedCount: number; reset: () => void }`
useState(0) for mask
useEffect on mount: read localStorage key, parseInt, setMask if !isNaN
isChecked(i): `Boolean(mask & (1 << i))`
toggle(i): `const next = mask ^ (1 << i); setMask(next); localStorage.setItem(key, String(next))`
checkedCount: count set bits up to count
Supports up to 30 steps (JS bitwise ops are 32-bit)
